dct_description_sm: Quantitative gamma-ray spectrometric and aeromagnetic helicopter-borne geophysical survey was completed by Fugro Airborne Surveys. The survey was flown from September 10 to October 14, 2008. The nominal traverse and control line spacings were 400 m and 2400 m respectively, and the aircraft flew at a nominal terrain clearance of 125 m. Traverse lines were oriented at 0 degrees with orthogonal control lines.
dct_title_s: Geophysical Series, NTS 115J/4, Airborne Geophysical Survey Southern Stevenson Ridge area, Yukon
